protocol.config_provenance: configs inherited from the published pipeline (real_gear_experiment.auto_params; FGR voxel 1.0); no parameter was tuned on the three reported scans in this run; solver params are CAD-scale-derived
protocol.interpretation_rule: material HV benefit per cell = success diff >= +20pp or paired median diff <= -10% (p2m) with bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0; Holm-adjusted McNemar reported across cells. The synthetic paired RRE effect is an ESTIMATION-ONLY endpoint (pilot shows a yaw-observability success floor: 2 planes + 6 cylinders cannot constrain rotation about the gear axis; teeth are not primitives), so no RRE materiality threshold is prespecified — RRE effects are reported with CIs and interpreted descriptively
protocol.shared_init_note: both arms start from the SAME init — synthetic: P @ inv(T_gt), P = U(0,2deg) rotation + N(0, 0.25%L) translation (pose-recovery-from-coarse, Table-A4 protocol); real: frozen FGR @ same per-trial perturbation. Differs from production verify() centroid init to isolate the hypothesis-set effect
protocol.candidate_generator: axis-plane slab cuts at 25/50/75% of the anchor extent, both sides (paper Sec 3.4 semantics); the shipped hypothesis.make_candidates box-window generator returns 0 candidates on this gear (anchors sit on the end faces) — logged as a finding
